'''Chandra Hobat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Politics|politician]], agriculturist and ecologist from [[Dayark]] in the [[Episol system]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], she served as the [[President/Legends|President]] of the [[Kathol Republic]].

==Biography==
A skilled [[Politics|politician]], Hobat was in her second term of office in 8 ABY. She focused the efforts of the Kathol Republic on long-term [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] and [[Farm/Legends|farming]] operations that would not come to fruition for several decades. Because of this, enthusiasm for Hobat's policies gradually fell away, and she had to rely on coalition of factions within the [[Kathol Republic Senatorial Council]].

After the [[Battle of Episol|incident]] that resulted in the loss of two [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] from the [[Kathol Republic Navy]], Hobat presided over the emergency session of the Senatorial Council that tried the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' for the crime. The crew managed to convince Hobat that they were not responsible for the act, and that representatives of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] were behind the attack, and had posed as members of the New Republic.

When the ''FarStar'' situation presented itself, Hobat realized that an alliance with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] could bring immediate benefits. However, she needed to convince the populace of the fact, but she could not openly support the ''FarStar'' crew since she would be openly standing against her chief rival, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sho'ban Do]], who was in a stronger political position.

After members of the ''FarStar'' crew proved that Do was involved in a plot to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Senatorial Council using [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and take over the Republic, support for Hobat returned. She agreed to a tentative alliance with New Republic to show her gratitude for the efforts of its representatives.
